what: recovery and overturn of the 1.3%/20.7% not-recoverable verdict: per-condition receipts found in the private receipt dataset and published on the chain

supersedes.why_superseded: the verification that issued the verdict could not access SZLHOLDINGS/model-eval-receipts (private) and declared permanence without covering it; the owner rejected the verdict and the receipts were found there on 2026-11-14
supersedes.how_named: this record names the earlier trace and its verdicts and supersedes them; the earlier record remains on the chain unchanged

coverage_lesson: no permanent-loss verdict may be issued while any estate store remains unchecked; verdicts must record the coverage set: what was searched, what was inaccessible, and why

the_series_restated.the_1_3_percent: the difference between the no-instruction baseline (4/150, 2.67%) and the prompt-rule condition (2/150, 1.33%): 1.33 percentage points of corpus acceptance; NOT a probe-response figure and NOT a quality claim
